===================

https://github.com/dannyfiresnake/libwing

WING Access includes a modified version of libwing and an adapted offline catalog.
Its license is included in libwing-LICENSE.txt and licenses/libwing/.

The included version has been modified for WING Access's communication,
parameter handling and metering needs.

License and copyright notices for dependencies are included in
licenses/<crate-version>/. Rust runtime notices are in licenses/rust-runtime/.
These components retain their respective license terms and rights.

Behringer WING initial settings, processor defaults and DAW control presets
https://www.behringer.com/en/wing

The initial settings, processor defaults and eight DAW control presets are based
on WING firmware 3.1.2 and WING Edit 3.3.4. DAW preset values are unchanged; their
file structure has been adapted for compatibility.
